problems.quote: net worth of ₹500 crore or more, turnover of ₹1,000 crore, or net profit of ₹5 crore in the preceding three financial years
problems.problem: The Companies Act 2013 (Section 135) requires the threshold to be met in the immediately preceding financial year, not over three years. The three-year reference applies to average net profit calculation for CSR spending, not the applicability criteria.
problems.correction: net worth of ₹500 crore or more, turnover of ₹1,000 crore, or net profit of ₹5 crore in the immediately preceding financial year
problems.verifierReason: Section 135(1) explicitly uses 'immediately preceding financial year' for applicability thresholds; three-year average is for spending calculation only.

problems.quote: shifting power from creditors to operational turnaround experts (Resolution Professional)
problems.problem: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016 shifted power from the debtor's management to the Committee of Creditors (CoC), not from creditors to the Resolution Professional. The RP acts under the CoC's oversight.
problems.correction: shifting power from debtors to creditors (Committee of Creditors)
problems.verifierReason: IBC shifts control from debtor's management to CoC; RP acts as agent under CoC oversight, not as principal power holder.

problems.quote: It also standardised the use of the chillu letters (ചില്ല്, നില്ല്, രില്ല്, ലില്ല്, ളില്ല്) as independent code points
problems.problem: The 1971 reform standardized chillu letters as glyphs for writing, not as "independent code points" (a Unicode concept from 2008). Also, "ചില്ല്" is not a chillu letter; the set is നില്ല്, രില്ല്, ലില്ല്, ളില്ല്, കില്ല്.
problems.correction: It also standardised the use of chillu letters (നില്ല്, രില്ല്, ലില്ല്, ളില്ല്, കില്ല്) as distinct glyphs, later encoded as independent code points in Unicode 5.1 (2008).
problems.verifierReason: 1971 reform standardized chillu as glyphs; Unicode code points came in 2008. List included invalid 'ചില്ല്'.

problems.problem: The Malayalam word for "eye" is കണ്ണ് (kaṇṇ), not കണ്ണി (kanni). The form കണില്ല് ends with chillu-ll (ൾ), not chillu-ṇ (ൺ), so it does not illustrate the claimed dialectal use of chillu-ṇ.
problems.correction: e.g., കൺ for കണ്‌ണ് (kaṇ, "eye") — using chillu-ṇ word-finally
problems.verifierReason: Word for 'eye' is കണ്ണ് (kaṇṇ), not കണ്ണി; example used wrong chillu (ൾ not ൺ).

problems.quote: writing ത്ര instead of ത്‌ര in words like മത്ര (matra, "measure")
problems.problem: The Sanskrit-derived word is മാത്ര (mātra), not മത്ര. The example misspells the word.
problems.correction: writing ത്ര instead of ത്‌ര in words like മാത്ര (mātra, "measure")
problems.verifierReason: Sanskrit loanword is മാത്ര (mātra), not മത്ര; missing long vowel.

problems.quote: visarga-to-h sandhi variant: അവന്‍റെ (avaṉṟe) becomes അവന്‍ഹെ
problems.problem: അവന്‍റെ contains no visarga (ഃ); the change from -ṟe to -he is a different phonological process, not a visarga-to-h shift.
problems.correction: a sandhi variant: അവന്‍റെ (avaṉṟe) becomes അവന്‍ഹെ
problems.verifierReason: No visarga in അവന്‍റെ; -ṟe to -he is a different sandhi process.
